description: For every elected official, there’s always the first election they won. For state Representative John Bell, that was a decade ago when he was a newlywed. His wife, Kelli Bell, says it was a quick turnaround from their wedding day to the campaign trail.
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY ELECT JOHN BELL COMMITTTEE
title: 'It’s a family thing': Cam­paigning for office is a team effort at the Bell home
